# GIMP GUI Interface Description

## Application Title Bar
- **Application Name**: GNU Image Manipulation Program
- **Window Title**: `[road_watermarked] (imported)-1.0 (RGB color 8-bit gamma integer, GIMP built-in sRGB, 1 layer) 1250x833 – GIMP`
- **Date and Time**: Oct 22 18:36
- **System Tray Icons**: Bell icon (notifications), system status icons (network, sound, power)

## Menu Bar
- **Menu Items**: File, Edit, Select, View, Image, Layer, Colors, Tools, Filters, Windows, Help

## Left Sidebar (Toolbox and Options)
### Tool Icons (Top to Bottom)
- Move Tool
- Rectangle Select Tool
- Free Select Tool
- Fuzzy Select Tool
- Pipette Tool
- Clone Tool
- Healing Tool
- Blur Tool
- Smudge Tool
- Eraser Tool
- Brush Tool
- Pencil Tool
- Airbrush Tool
- Text Tool
- Zoom Tool
- Hand Tool

### Tool Options Panel (Crop Tool Active)
- **Crop Tool Options**:
  - `Current layer only`: unchecked
  - `Delete cropped pixels`: unchecked
  - `Allow growing`: unchecked
  - `Expand from center`: unchecked
  - `Fixed`: checked
  - `Aspect ratio`: dropdown menu (1250:83 selected)
  - `Position`: X: 0 px, Y: 0 px
  - `Size`: Width: 0 px, Height: 0 px
  - `Highlight`: Highlight opacity: 50.0
  - `No guides`: dropdown menu
  - `Auto Shrink`: button
  - `Shrink merged`: unchecked

## Main Canvas Area
- **Image Content**: A landscape photo of a road stretching into the distance, flanked by red rock formations under an orange sky.
- **Watermark**: "© PhotoMarks" in the bottom right corner.
- **Selection**: The entire image is selected with a yellow dashed border.
- **Modal Dialog Box**:
  - **Title**: Reset all Filters
  - **Message**: "Do you really want to reset all filters to default values?"
  - **Buttons**: Cancel, Reset
  - **Close Button**: X in the top right corner of the dialog

## Right Sidebar (Layers and Filters)
### Layers Panel
- **Layer Name**: `road_watermarked`
- **Layer Visibility**: Eye icon (visible)
- **Layer Thumbnail**: Preview of the image

### Filters Panel
- **Filter Selection**: `2. Hardness 050 (51 x 51)`
- **Filter Preview**: Various brush and hardness options displayed
- **Filter Settings**:
  - `Basic,`
  - `Spacing`: 10.0
  - **Tool Options**:
    - `Mode`: Normal
    - `Opacity`: 100.0
    - `Lock`: Lock options (move, transparency, position)

## Bottom Status Bar
- **Coordinates**: -72, -240
- **Units**: px
- **Zoom Level**: 66.7%
- **Instruction**: "Click-Drag to draw a crop rectangle"

## System Dock (Left Side)
- **Application Icons**:
  - Google Chrome
  - Thunderbird
  - Visual Studio Code
  - VLC Media Player
  - LibreOffice Writer
  - LibreOffice Calc
  - LibreOffice Impress
  - GIMP (active)
  - File Manager
  - Software Center
  - Help
  - Trash

## Bottom Dock (System Tray)
- **System Icons**: Network, Sound, Power

## Additional UI Elements
- **Scrollbars**: Vertical scrollbar on the right side of the canvas
- **Gridlines**: Visible gridlines on the canvas
- **Rulers**: Horizontal and vertical rulers at the top and left edges of the canvas
- **Tool Tips**: Tool tips visible for some tools
- **Status Bar**: Displays current tool and action instructions

## Dialog Box Details
- **Title Bar**: "Reset all Filters"
- **Message**: "Do you really want to reset all filters to default values?"
- **Buttons**: Cancel, Reset
- **Close Button**: X in the top right corner of the dialog

## Image Metadata
- **File Name**: `[road_watermarked] (imported)-1.0`
- **Color Mode**: RGB color 8-bit gamma integer
- **Color Profile**: GIMP built-in sRGB
- **Layers**: 1 layer
- **Dimensions**: 1250x833 pixels

## Tool Selection
- **Current Tool**: Crop Tool (indicated by the active tool icon and options panel)
- **Tool Options**: Crop tool options
